symbols.read: Price has extended the decline to 740.33, breaking below the 737.2–737.9 FVG that previously anchored the bullish support stack — the four-FVG base now sits lower at 725.47–732.87, so the structure has weakened rather than merely stalled. The 4H stays bearish and combined signal remains HOLD, with the 1H trend down and the 758.57 short still MISSED, though the lower pivot at 758.57 now defines the invalidation line. Overhead supply at 761.47–761.54 remains the cap, and the 721.33 target is unchanged below the reduced support stack. Bias stays bearish with conviction still weak — invalidation is a reclaim of 758.57, hard stop 775.89, and the BULLISH regime tag continues to conflict with the bearish structure.

Bias stays neutral-to-constructive but has weakened: price at 82,758.01 has slipped from 83,090.89 and is now only ~530 above the 82,227.56 lower pivot, while the last 1H print flipped negative (-0.19%, 83,040.20→82,884.00) versus the prior read's decisive +0.82% up bar. The SELL setup remains invalidated and the BULLISH regime non-conflicting, with both bull FVGs at 81,028.74–81,425.50 and 81,996.01–82,045.45 still untouched below as support. The key line is 82,227.56 — a 4H close below it revives the short toward 77,730.00 (stop 82,413.00), while holding keeps 86,725.12 as the upside reference.

Price has slipped to 2,490.83, confirming the bearish lean from the prior read — the 2,527.57 pivot was never reclaimed and now sits as the upper pivot, with the SELL setup at that level having expired without a structural break. The 4H direction remains bearish and the 1H trend is still down, so the bias stays neutral-to-bearish, with the 2,465.96–2,468.65 bull FVG as the immediate support shelf and 2,449.65–2,464.60 stacked just below it. A close above 2,527.57 is still the trigger to break the bearish structure and open the 2,551.76–2,556.06 bear FVG, while failure to reclaim it keeps the path toward the 2,427.00–2,443.52 bull FVG and the 2,320.59 target intact. Invalidation of the bearish lean remains a close above 2,537.64, and the BULLISH regime tag still argues against aggressive short sizing.

Bias stays bearish and the prior read is confirmed: price at 109.66 remains capped under the broken pivot at 115.26, 4H is still bearish, and 108.23 stays the downside objective. What changed is momentum — the last 1H printed -0.35% (110.09→109.71), reversing the prior +1.42% push, so the press into overhead supply has stalled and price is rolling back toward the demand stack. The bear FVG at 112.89–113.14 remains the first resistance capping any continuation, while the bull FVG at 108.00–108.07 still sits directly on top of the 108.23 target as the first real test of whether the downside continues. Combined reads HOLD with the SELL still flagged missed since entry and stop are both 115.26. Invalidation is unchanged: a 4H close above 115.26 flips the read neutral and voids the broken-pivot thesis, while losing 108.00 opens the next leg down.

XAGUSD has pushed to 60.91, extending the same grind above the 59.07 shelf with the 1H trend still up and the 4H still bearish — the watching stance holds for a fourth straight read, unchanged in structure. The bull FVG stack remains five zones from 59.12 to 60.02 beneath price as support, and the combined 4H+1H stays HOLD. Bias remains bearish-but-pending: the short only re-arms on a break back below 58.50, with 58.72 the invalidation stop and 55.14 the target. Sustained trade above 58.72 keeps the setup sidelined, and 61.87 remains the upside pivot — a break above it flips the regime to a long setup with entry 61.87, stop 61.66, and target 65.24.

Price has recovered to 4,188.55, reclaiming the 4,185.90 pivot and clearing the 4,186.86–4,187.15 bear FVG that capped the prior read — the pullback that had knocked the setup back to watching has been absorbed, and the combined signal has flipped from HOLD to BUY. The 4H stays bullish and the 1H trend is up, but the only remaining open FVG is the deep bull gap at 4,140.87–4,141.58, meaning price now runs without nearby bullish imbalance support beneath it. Bias is long, with entry at the 4,207.48 upper pivot, stop 4,199.08, target 4,348.43; invalidation is a break below 4,199.08, which would leave the 4,140.87–4,141.58 FVG as the next structural defense. Regime is still NEUTRAL, so this remains a trigger-based breakout entry rather than an aligned trend trade.

The short from 1.39 is invalidated: price never broke down, and the regime has flipped to bullish with a fresh 1H bull FVG at 1.3463–1.3597 now acting as the structural shelf beneath price. The 1.39 lower pivot has held as support rather than flipping to resistance, so the prior "no shelf to 1.25" premise is dead — the 4H remains bearish but the combined 4H+1H read is HOLD, not short. Bias is neutral-to-long while 1.38 holds above the 1.3463–1.3597 FVG, with 1.53 as the upside pivot; invalidation is a close below 1.3463, which would void the bull FVG and re-open the 1.25 target.
